notice_title.text: Municipal Corporation Final Property Tax Assessment & Demand Notice (FY 2026-27)
notice_title.evidence_quote: Municipal Corporation Final Property Tax Assessment & Demand Notice (FY 2026-27)

issuing_organisation.text: Directorate of Municipal Revenue, Property Tax Department
issuing_organisation.evidence_quote: Directorate of Municipal Revenue, Property Tax Department

affected_party.text: All municipal property owners and rate-payers
affected_party.evidence_quote: All assessees are required to clear property tax dues

main_purpose.text: Demand settlement of property tax dues for FY 2026-27 prior to recovery enforcement
main_purpose.evidence_quote: clear property tax dues for FY 2026-27 by 30-11-2026 failing which recovery actions shall commence

plain_language_summary.what_is_this: This is an official final property tax assessment and demand order for the financial year 2026-27.
plain_language_summary.why_it_matters: Failure to remit payment will trigger an additional 2% monthly penal surcharge and potential civic service disconnection.
plain_language_summary.what_to_do: Verify your property dues using your 10-digit PID and pay the assessed tax in full.
plain_language_summary.where_to_do_it: Pay online at https://propertytax.citygov.in/portal or in-person at municipal Citizen Service Centers.
plain_language_summary.if_deadline_missed: A 2% monthly penal interest is added after November 30, followed by attachment of property after 90 days.

deadlines.description: Final date for payment of property tax without 2% monthly penal interest.
deadlines.evidence_quote: Payment must be completed on or before 30th November 2026 to avoid penal interest.

deadlines.description: Early-bird rebate deadline eligible for 5% tax concession.
deadlines.evidence_quote: An early payment rebate of 5% is applicable if payment is recorded by 31-10-2026.

required_documents.name: Previous Year Tax Paid Receipt (FY 2025-26)
required_documents.evidence_quote: Photocopy of previous financial year tax clearance receipt is compulsory for verification.

required_documents.name: Property Unique ID (PID) Card
required_documents.evidence_quote: Original PID smart card or system generated PID slip must be cited.

required_documents.name: Building Completion Certificate
required_documents.evidence_quote: Owners of newly constructed floors may submit completion certificate to claim revised assessment (optional).

submission_channel.channel: https://propertytax.citygov.in/portal or Citizen Service Centers (Civic Centers Room 104)
submission_channel.evidence_quote: Tax may be remitted online at https://propertytax.citygov.in/portal or in-person at Citizen Service Centers.

penalties.description: Penal interest of 2% per month on overdue tax amount
penalties.evidence_quote: A simple interest penalty of 2% per month on defaulted tax will be added after 30-11-2026.

penalties.description: Warrant of attachment and disconnection of municipal civic services
penalties.evidence_quote: Non-payment exceeding 90 days may result in attachment of movable property and disconnection of water connection.

action_steps.action: Locate Property Identification Number (PID) and inspect current dues breakdown on municipal portal.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 1: Assessees should log in with their 10-digit PID to inspect tax liability details.

action_steps.action: Gather previous year receipt and upload self-assessment form online or submit at Civic Center counter.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 2: Submit self-assessment declaration with previous receipt attached.

action_steps.action: Complete payment through authorized payment gateway or generate bank challan.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 3: Complete payment through authorized payment gateway or generate bank challan.

warnings.warning_text: Non-payment exceeding 90 days leads to statutory asset attachment proceedings.
warnings.evidence_quote: Non-payment exceeding 90 days may result in attachment of movable property
